name: KyoceraAVX-taj
title: TAJ series moulded solid tantalum chip capacitors, J-lead, standard and low profile
summary: TAJ is a family of general-purpose surface-mount tantalum capacitors with a manganese dioxide cathode, a resin-moulded body and J-formed leads. Seventeen case sizes cover 0.10 µF to 2200 µF and 2.5 V to 50 V, from the 0805-size P and R cases to the 2924-size U and V cases, with low-profile cases as thin as 1.0 mm. Every part is surge-current tested; capacitance tolerance is ±10% or ±20%, and the parts work from -55 °C to +125 °C with voltage derated above +85 °C.

operation.text: The capacitor is polarised. The band moulded into the body marks the anode (+) end.
Rated voltage VR applies up to +85 °C and category voltage VC up to +125 °C. Surge voltage limits are higher than these, listed separately for +85 °C and +125 °C.
Each capacitor is surge-current tested in production.
Each part has an RMS current limit at 100 kHz, given for +25 °C, +85 °C and +125 °C, alongside its maximum ESR at 100 kHz.

Most parts are MSL 1. For the parts flagged ¹⁾ in the ratings table, dry pack (suffix V) is recommended to reduce soldering stress, and a dry-packed part is treated as MSL 3. The six part numbers ending in V are rated MSL 3.
Low-power DC/DC converters and LDO regulators, entertainment and infotainment systems, and height-restricted designs.
